source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A sacred shrine or temple: calm, reverent and luminous, candlelight and incense, time standing still. Tempo 60 BPM, 4/4 time, key of A major. Instrumentation: soft wordless choir pad (no words), pipe organ, tubular bells, harp, warm strings, no drums. Form: slow chorale, gentle harp interlude, chorale again. Duration: 70 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
